chronological_validation.embargo_rule: For each target, embargo its label-specific embargo_exchange_sessions at the start of each validation window from scored rows; score only targets whose endpoints remain inside that validation fold.
chronological_validation.final_untouched_holdout: NOT INCLUDED in this registry sample; reserved for a separately authorized fresh-forward phase. Do not use these folds to tune after review.
chronological_validation.horizon_end_rule: Score a validation label only when its target endpoint is within the same registered validation window and within dataset date bounds.

inner_validation.calibration: Build training-only out-of-fold predictions from these three inner folds; fit calibrators and abstention/gating thresholds only on these out-of-fold predictions. Refit the final family estimator on the full eligible outer-training set after calibration choices are frozen.
inner_validation.if_any_inner_fold_fails: Block that config/fold before fitting; do not silently change the split or use a random split.
inner_validation.split_policy: Within each outer training window, sort eligible official NSE exchange sessions and form three expanding inner folds with validation intervals at session-index quantiles [0.40, 0.60), [0.60, 0.80), and [0.80, 1.00). Each inner fold trains only on sessions strictly earlier than its validation start. Apply the label-specific purge_exchange_sessions and embargo_exchange_sessions from the R3 label manifest, exclude any training label whose target interval intersects validation, and require every training target endpoint to be observable at the training cutoff. No random split or result-driven fold adjustment is permitted.

chronological_validation.purge_rule: For each target, exclude training labels whose target interval intersects the validation period and purge the last label-specific purge_exchange_sessions before validation; also require every training target endpoint to be observable at the training cutoff.
chronological_validation.session_interpretation: Calendar boundaries above are fixed. Only actual official exchange sessions with eligible source rows count; no fold boundary may be shifted to improve sample size.
chronological_validation.training: for each fold, train on all eligible observations from 2021-10-11 up to the pre-validation boundary using an expanding window; previous validation periods may enter later folds' training only after their targets are fully known and all transformations are refit from scratch.

fitting_and_calibration.hyperparameters: Only the frozen configuration fields in the committed config shard may be used; no ad-hoc tuning or model-family substitution.
fitting_and_calibration.inner_validation: Use deterministic expanding inner chronological folds contained wholly in the current outer training window. For each label, apply its horizon-specific purge and embargo from the R3 label manifest; remove training labels whose target endpoint is not observable at the training cutoff or overlaps validation. No random split, fixed one-session purge override, or results-driven fold change is permitted.
fitting_and_calibration.preprocessing: Fit imputation, scaling, feature selection, dimensionality reduction, regime thresholds, class priors and all target-dependent transforms on training rows only.
fitting_and_calibration.prevalence_baseline: Training-fold positive prevalence with fixed Jeffreys smoothing p=(n_positive+0.5)/(n_train+1), then clip to [1e-6,1-1e-6]; baseline is scored on exactly the same common evaluation rows as candidate.
fitting_and_calibration.probability_calibration: Native probabilities when family contract proves semantics; otherwise train-only Platt calibration on predictions made out-of-fold within inner chronological folds. No outer-validation targets used to fit or choose calibration.

historical_scope_amendments.note: The R2 two-target synthetic/design pilot restriction is historical. R3 reuses the R2 base design but defines all ten required horizons; this history object does not authorize fitting. R3's own developer registry/data-preflight gate remains controlling.

before_empirical_fitting: Freeze and independently approve all ten target-label definitions and their sample-eligibility rules.
Regenerate the configuration universe for all ten labels, with horizon-specific target maturity, purge, embargo, and fold-end rules.
Regenerate and pin all expanded configuration shards, indexes, manifests, and synthetic reports.
Obtain a distinct independent tester PASS for the horizon-complete registry and statistical protocol.
explicit_non_claims: R2 does not cover the full frozen intraday horizon set of 5/15/30/60/120 minutes.
R2 does not cover the full frozen positional horizon set of +1/+2/+3/+5/+10 exchange sessions.
R2 pilot rows and any future pilot metrics cannot establish exhaustive horizon coverage or justify final cross-horizon model ranking.
original_amendment.purpose: The current 1,000-method / 8,000-configuration R2 registry is a finite pilot to validate method identity, conservative family/operator compatibility, statistical utilities, artifact integrity, and synthetic runner orchestration for one representative intraday target and one representative positional target.
original_amendment.rationale: This clarification retains the already committed 8,000-configuration R2 artifact as a bounded synthetic/design pilot and avoids a silent post-result scope change. It does not reduce the full research aim; all ten frozen horizons remain mandatory before any empirical fitting or method selection.

abstention_operator.cutoff_rule: 80th percentile of predictive Bernoulli entropy estimated from inner chronological training out-of-fold predictions; never estimate cutoff on outer validation data

bootstrap.confidence_interval: percentile interval of paired mean log-loss improvement across replicates
bootstrap.method: Paired moving-block bootstrap of per-exchange-session baseline-minus-candidate log-loss improvements. Within each outer fold, sample contiguous ten-session blocks with replacement until the original fold's session count is reached; never cross fold boundaries and use the same resampled session indices for candidate and baseline. Center the bootstrap distribution under the null for the two-sided p-value. If the resampling distribution is degenerate, retain the observed mean descriptively and report null confidence limits and p-value.
bootstrap.raw_p_value: center bootstrap replicates under the null by subtracting observed improvement; two-sided p=(1 + count(|centered_delta| >= |observed_delta|))/(B+1)
bootstrap.resampling_unit: Exchange sessions within each outer fold; fixed ten-session moving blocks; never cross outer-fold boundaries. Candidate and baseline share the same sampled session indices. If the empirical bootstrap distribution is degenerate, report descriptive mean only and null CI/p-value.

multiplicity.count_basis: At most 426 conditionally compatible methods × 4 configurations per label. Freeze eligible family membership after developer-side compatibility/sample screening and before computing any outer-validation metric.
multiplicity.family_definition: one fixed testing family per label stratum, comprising every pre-registered configuration that passes the pre-result compatibility and sample-eligibility gates for that label; family membership freezes before any outer-validation metric is computed
multiplicity.order_of_operations: freeze eligible configuration membership, compute paired block-bootstrap raw p-values, apply BY within each label stratum, and report all configurations including rejected/blocked entries

metrics_and_inference.primary_effect_direction: Positive baseline_log_loss - candidate_log_loss favors the candidate.

output_and_failure_rules.encrypted_data: Dataset manifest remains encrypted_only=true. The developer data-preflight workflow must verify every encrypted part hash/size, decode only in temporary runner storage, verify canonical decoded digest/row totals/date coverage/session schema, and remove plaintext on job exit. This R3 registry builder does not decrypt or read market data.
output_and_failure_rules.holdout_protection: No untouched holdout path/secret is read or written by R2 tooling.
output_and_failure_rules.result_acquisition: Preserve every config/fold row including blocked, failed, null and non-significant outputs. The acquired result bundle is frozen and hash-pinned before one consolidated independent tester review.
output_and_failure_rules.technical_failures: Persist one JSONL record with config/fold/step/exception and traceback hash; do not retry with altered inputs silently.

sample_eligibility.common_panel: Within each label stratum and outer fold, all compatible candidates use the same decision rows. Feature values are imputed with training-fold-only statistics; do not silently drop rows candidate-by-candidate.
sample_eligibility.duplicates: deduplicate only byte-identical (instrument, exchange timestamp, interval) rows; conflicting duplicates block the affected source/fold pending reconciliation
sample_eligibility.fail_closed: If any fold/stratum fails row, class-support, coverage, timestamp or missingness minima, mark that fold/config BLOCKED_SAMPLE_ELIGIBILITY; do not relax rules or substitute a later date window.
sample_eligibility.feature_missingness_rule: Within each training fold, median-impute numeric features and add a missingness indicator using training rows only. If a feature exceeds 20% missingness or all values are missing, exclude it. If more than 20% of registered features in a representation are excluded, block that representation/configuration before fitting.
sample_eligibility.infinities: convert +/- infinity to missing, then apply the registered training-only missingness rule; report counts

dataset_id_range_claim.note: Dates are from the committed dataset identifier. The manifest says encrypted_only=true; actual decrypted timestamp coverage has not been verified. Missing coverage fails closed; dates must not be shifted post-result.

scope.objective: NIFTY 50 directional probability prediction at the complete frozen ten-horizon scope; no option strategy selection in this prediction sub-study.
scope.preregistration_note: R3 freezes the complete ten-horizon prediction scope before empirical metrics are computed. The encrypted dataset must pass the developer-side data preflight and exact-pinned registry tests before fitting. Independent tester review is deferred until all planned prediction results are acquired and frozen.
prohibited_until_gate_passes: empirical model fitting before developer-side ten-horizon registry QA and data preflight pass
changing target/fold/feature/compatibility rules after inspecting results
scope.review_cadence: Independent tester review is deferred until the complete planned result bundle is acquired, frozen, and hashed.
